description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G has been launched in India, marking 10 years of the company’s F series in the country. Here are our first impressions. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G is offered in three colour options, including Sunset Orange, Twilight Brown, and Wave Blue. I got the orange option, which appears to be the most eye-catching and appealing out of the lot. The smartphone feels light to hold and offers a good in-hand feel. It continues to sport the Smile Curve Design rear camera module, which was also seen last year on the Oppo F33 Pro 5G.
title: Oppo F35 Pro 5G First Impressions

description: Vivo Y600K Turbo has been launched in China by the smartphone maker. The handset is currently available for purchase in China via the Vivo online store. The Vivo Y600K Turbo is offered in Dune Gold, Electric Blue, and Millennial Pink (translated from Chinese) shades. The Vivo Y600K Turbo is a dual-SIM smartphone. It runs on Vivo’s OriginOS 6, which is based on Android 16. The phone sports a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate. Qualcomm’s octa-core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, which is built on a 4nm process, powers the Vivo Y600K Turbo. The Vivo Y600K Turbo is backed by a 9,000mAh battery with support for 90W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo Y600K Turbo Launched With 9,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: The Realme P4s Lite is positioned as a lower-cost addition to the company's P4 lineup, with a large display and high-capacity battery among its key specifications. It uses the Unisoc T7250 chipset with 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of storage. The phone also offers a 13-megapixel rear camera, 15W charging and a 3.5mm headphone jack. Realme has priced the handset below Rs. 20,000 in India, with two storage configurations and two colour options.
title: Realme P4s Lite Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 120Hz Display: Price, Features

description: The Redmi Note 17 Pro Max takes a different approach to the Pro Max moniker, putting its massive 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery ahead of performance and cameras. It offers excellent endurance, a bright 1.5K AMOLED display, 100W charging, and extensive IP ratings. However, the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset and average camera setup feel out of place at Rs. 49,999.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max Review: A 10,000mAh Battery Beast

description: Google will change Gemini model access for free and AI Plus subscribers from October 9. Free users will only have access to Flash-Lite, while AI Plus will retain Flash-Lite and Flash but lose Pro. AI Pro and AI Ultra will continue to offer all three models, with Deep Think also coming to AI Pro. Google is considering Low, Medium and High thinking-effort options for Gemini. Meanwhile, Gemini 4 Argon is being tested through Fairwind before reaching paid API customers and AI Ultra subscribers.
title: Google Gemini Plans Get New Limits: Free Users Lose Flash, AI Pro Gets Deep Think

description: Boat has introduced four new power banks in India, covering wired fast charging and magnetic wireless charging across different capacities. The Apex PB400, PB400 Pro and PB445 each pack 20,000mAh batteries, while the PB332 MagnaCharge has a 10,000mAh battery. The flagship PB445 supports 45W two-way charging, while the PB332 MagnaCharge offers 15W magnetic wireless charging and a built-in stand. Prices for the new models range from Rs. 1,999 to Rs. 2,899 in India.
title: Boat Apex Powerbank Series With Up to 45W Charging, Up to 20,000mAh Battery Launched Alongside Wireless MagnaCharge

description: Xiaomi Festive Offers have been announced by the tech giant, offering discounts on Xiaomi, Redmi, and Mijia devices, including phones, tablets, smartwatches, power banks, air purifiers, and smart TVs. The Redmi A7 Pro 5G will be available at a net effective price of Rs. 15,499. The budget smartphone features a 6.9-inch HD+ LCD touchscreen, delivering up to a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 800 nits peak brightness, while packing a 6,300mAh battery. Similarly, the Redmi Note 15 series, including the Redmi Note 15 SE 5G, Note 15 Pro 5G, and Note 15 5G, will also be offered at discounted prices of Rs. 22,999, Rs. 28,999, and Rs. 26,999, respectively.
title: Xiaomi Festive Offers Announced: Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Redmi Turbo 5, Mijia Air Purifier 4 Compact and More

description: Noise Master Buds Open are now available for pre-booking in India. The company says its latest open-ear true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds mark its foray into the growing open-ear audio segment. The earbuds feature Sound by Bose technology and come with a 10.8mm custom dynamic driver. Noise says they also have an ergonomic C-bridge design for all-day comfort. Other features include dual-device connectivity, four-mic ENC DNN technology for calls, and up to 28 hours of total playback.
title: Noise Master Buds Open With Bose-Tuned Audio Now Available for Pre-Booking in India: Price, Specifications

description: Huawei and Qualcomm announced a new multi-year patent licensing agreement on Monday, subject to the necessary regulatory approvals. The partnership covers several technology areas, including 5G, computing, artificial intelligence (AI), and networking. Following the agreement, the companies will take advantage of cross-licensing of Huawei and Qualcomm’s respective patent portfolios. Further, the US-based chipmaker will also acquire certain Huawei patents registered in the US. Huawei highlighted its contributions to 4G and 5G standards, while Qualcomm pointed to its foundational wireless technologies and 5G licensing programme.
title: Huawei, Qualcomm Announce Multi-Year Patent Licensing Agreement Covering 5G, AI and More

description: Vivo S60t was recently launched in China as the newest member of the S60 series. The new handset is currently on sale in China via the Vivo online store. The Vivo S60t is offered in Early Summer Green, Midsummer Night, and Starry Sea (translated from Chinese) colourways. The Vivo S60t is a dual-SIM smartphone. It runs on Vivo’s latest OriginOS 7, which is based on Android 17. It sports a 6.59-inch Full-HD+ (1,260 x 2,750 pixels) AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 144Hz. An octa-core Snapdragon 7 Gen 2 chipset from Qualcomm powers the Vivo S60t, featuring three efficiency cores clocked at 1.8GHz, four performance cores clocked at 2.4GHz, and a prime core, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.8GHz.
title: Vivo S60t Launched With 50-Megapixel Telephoto Camera, MediaTek Dimensity 7 Gen 4 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI is offering a limited-time free trial of its ChatGPT Plus subscription in India. With this move, the San Francisco-based AI company is providing eligible users with access to the paid tier of the AI chatbot without the usual monthly charge. The offer is currently visible to select users and provides one month of the ChatGPT Plus plan at no cost. However, the promotion does not appear to be available to every account.
title: ChatGPT Plus Is Free for One Month in India: Here’s How to Claim It

description: Tesla's camera-based approach to autonomous driving is facing renewed attention after Elon Musk linked night-time animal detection to the Robotaxi's operating hours in Austin. The company has continued to reject lidar in favour of cameras and AI, while rivals such as Waymo use a mix of sensors. An Electrek report examined how lidar and radar could offer additional information in poor visibility. Tesla's approach is also under regulatory review following an investigation into Full Self-Driving crashes in low-visibility conditions.
title: Tesla Robotaxi Gets Longer Austin Hours as Musk Defends Cameras Against Lidar

description: Apple devices, including the iPhone 17, MacBook Neo, MacBook Air with the M5 processor, iPad with the A19 chip, iPad Air with the M4 processor, and AirPods Pro 3, will be available at discounted prices during the upcoming Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 and Flipkart Big Billion Days 2026 sale events. Flipkart will offer the iPhone 17 and iPhone 15 at discounted prices, while Amazon will list the iPhone 16 at a relatively low price. The handsets will be available at Rs. 79,900, Rs. 71,999, and Rs. 63,999, respectively. Amazon will offer an instant discount of 10 percent with SBI debit and credit cards and credit card EMI transactions. Meanwhile, Flipkart will offer an instant discount of 10 percent with Axis Bank and ICICI Bank credit cards.
title: iPhone 17, MacBook Neo and More to Be Discounted During Upcoming Amazon, Flipkart Sales: Offers

description: Google Fitbit Edge will be launched in select global markets later this year, according to a report. Apart from this, the purported computer-aided design (CAD) renders of the rumoured fitness tracker have also surfaced online, hinting at its form factor and design. The report suggests that Google’s Fitbit Edge will be available for purchase in three colour options, including black, green, and orange. Further, the Google Fitbit Edge is shown to feature a pill-shaped display. Users will be able to receive notifications and alerts on their wrists. It is said to ship with similar features to the Fitbit Charge series.
title: Google Fitbit Edge to Reportedly Launch Soon Globally as Design Renders Surface Online

description: Vivo X Fold 6 is set to launch in India on October 6 alongside the Vivo V80 and Vivo S2 FE. The upcoming foldable was launched in China in June and features an 8.02-inch inner AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super chipset and carries a 7,000mAh battery with 80W wired and 40W wireless charging. Vivo has also teased what appears to be a mixed reality headset, although its India availability remains uncertain.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 India Launch Date Confirmed, Mixed Reality Headset Teased

description: Sony said QSSR was an evolution of Sony's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) upscaler available on PS5 Pro. In its announcement last week, the company said the upscaling technology's computation demand had made it impossible to implement on the base PS5. QSSR represents a "performance tier" of AI upscaling and is now available on the base PS5 for Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei.
title: Sony Rolls Out QSSR AI Upscaler for Base PS5 in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei

description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G have been launched in India as the latest additions to the company's mid-range lineup. The new smartphones are set to go on sale in India later this month via Flipkart, Amazon, and the Oppo online store. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G is offered in Sunset Orange, Twilight Brown, and Wave Blue colourways. Meanwhile, the Oppo F35 5G ships in Mist Pink, Titanium Grey, and Wave Blue colour options. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G are equipped with a 50-megapixel selfie camera. Moreover, both handsets feature a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Oppo F35 Pro 5G and Oppo F35 5G Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Selfie Camera: Price, Specifications

description: India’s smart glasses market has been steadily expanding in recent years. There are several options now available, catering to different use cases. Homegrown brands like Pebble and Lenskart both offer glasses with built-in cameras for users who want to capture content on-the-go. The most popular option, however, remains the Ray-Ban Meta Glasses, which combine the conventional eyewear design with a built-in camera, speakers, microphones, and Meta AI features. If you’re in the market for a pair of smart glasses, then Meta’s first-generation glasses are already available with a significant discount ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale.
title: Ray-Ban Meta Glasses Gen 1 Price Drops to Near Rs. 15,000 on Amazon Ahead of Festive Sale

description: Realme has announced its festive offers ahead of the Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale in India. The company will offer discounts and benefits worth Rs. 500 crore across its smartphone and AIoT portfolio. As part of the “Real Wali Diwali” campaign, customers can avail of price cuts, bank offers, exchange bonuses, and no-cost EMI options on several Realme smartphones, including the Realme P4 Power, Realme P4x, and Realme P4 5G.
title: Realme P4, P4 Power, P4x and More to Get Discounts During Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale

description: Apple CEO John Ternus is spending more time with the company’s industrial design and human interface teams, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. The CEO reportedly visits the design studio several times each week as Apple works to strengthen the teams after a number of senior departures. Ternus took charge of the groups during his transition from hardware engineering chief to CEO. Apple has appointed Molly Anderson and Steve Lemay to lead the respective teams but is not seeking a single executive to oversee both.
title: Apple CEO John Ternus Reportedly Takes Closer Control of Design Teams

description: Following the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro models alongside the iPhone Duo earlier this year, the focus now appears to be shifting towards Apple’s MacBook lineup. A seasoned journalist claims that the Cupertino-based tech giant could be preparing a major design refresh. The next-generation models are expected to introduce several changes. The redesigned MacBook Pro could reportedly be thinner and considerably lighter than current models, while also bringing touchscreen support.
title: Redesigned MacBook Pro With OLED, Touchscreen Could Be ‘Significantly Lighter’, Gurman Claims

description: After announcing the iQOO 16 in China, the phone is finally making its way to global markets, including India. A device tagged as the Vivo I2607 has been spotted on Geekbench, revealing benchmark performance and core specifications.
title: iQOO 16 Indian Variant Spotted on Geekbench Revealing Key Specifications: What You Need to Know

description: With the festive season in India around the corner, various e-commerce platforms have announced exciting offers on a wide range of products. But it is not just hardware that is on offer. Adobe has revealed that eligible students can get a free one-year subscription to Photoshop. As part of the offer, users can access the photo-editing software without paying its usual annual price of Rs. 1,999. The offer is available through the official Adobe website. It requires users to provide their college details before completing the process. The promotion is primarily aimed at students and is not available for all accounts.
title: Adobe Photoshop Is Free for a Year for Students in India: How to Claim the Offer
